Subject: POC kickoff — aligning owners, timeline, and success criteria

Amanda / Rajiv —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our call, we'd like to lock the POC kickoff so engineering, security, and procurement have a single alignment session before we hand off the technical deep-dive. Proposed goals for the kickoff: 

- Confirm success criteria (latency / throughput targets, acceptable edge cases)
- Agree on timeline & milestone owners (who owns test data, network access, evaluation)
- Identify immediate blockers (procurement steps, SOC2 evidence, firewall rules)

I attached a short POC agenda and a checklist we use to speed the first week. Can you confirm who from your side should be present for the kickoff? My recommendation is: AE + SE (that's me + Olga), customer engineering (Rajiv), procurement (Sarah), and security (Mike) — if that aligns.

Proposed kickoff windows (PST):
- Tue May 11, 10:00–11:00 or 15:00–16:00
- Wed May 12, 09:00–10:00

If none of those work, send a couple of alternate slots and we'll prioritize. I also dropped a shared folder here: https://drive.redwood.example.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C/poc-pegasus for pre-reads.

Attaching: POC-Agenda.pdf, Network-Access-Checklist.xlsx

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.example.com
+1 (650) 555-0147

Thanks, that looks good. Please add Sarah (procurement) and Mike (security) — copying them here. Rajiv and I can attend but Wed morning is tight for our infra team. Our prefered windows (PST):

- Tue May 11, 15:00–16:00 (works for Rajiv)
- Thu May 13, 11:00–12:00 (backup)

1) Procurement will want a draft mutual action plan and a high-level SOW so they can start internal approvals.
2) Security wants SOC2 artifact references and a network diagram; Mike, can you confirm exactly which docs you need?

Appreciate the heads-up. Quick technical notes to make the kickoff productive: 
- We should plan a 30-minute technical session for Rajiv + infra to walk through network access, sample payloads, and a short run of the evaluation prompt set.
- Followed by a 20-minute session for procurement/security to cover contractual/RBAC questions and SOC2 scoping.

If Tue 15:00–16:00 PST is still an option, that schedule would allow us to break the time into 30/20 + buffer. Otherwise Thu 11:00–12:00 PST also works.

Also adding: Network-Access-Checklist.xlsx includes the minimal firewall rules and IP ranges. If you can confirm network owner who can open a ticket ahead of time that will save time on day one.

Subject: Re: POC kickoff — aligning owners, timeline, and success criteria

Ben / Team —

Thanks for the draft plan. Procurement can do an initial review of the MAP and SOW, but we typically require the following items before a kickoff if we are to commit legal resources within the same week: 
- Draft SOW (high-level milestones & acceptance criteria)
- NDA or mutual confidentiality clause (we can use our standard template)
- Point of contact for purchase order & vendor onboarding (I'll be the main contact)

If you need us to sign an NDA immediately, please route it to procurement@pegasushealth.com. I'm okay with Thu May 13, 11:00–12:00 PST but if legal can't start until we have the draft SOW, we may need to push the technical deep-dive by a few days.

For transparency: procurement will also check data retention and any subprocessing. I noted you called out SOC2 — Mike, we'll follow up separately on the artifact list.

Best,
Sarah Klein
Sr. Procurement Manager, Pegasus Health

Date: 2027-05-11T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Confirmed: Thu May 13 11:00–12:00 PST — POC kickoff (owners & success criteria)

Thanks everyone — locking Thu May 13, 11:00–12:00 PST. Calendar invite sent. Quick owner assignments for the kickoff to keep us efficient: 

- Redwood AE: Ben Carter — overall timeline & commercial questions
- Redwood SE: Olga Petrov — technical demo & test plan owner
- Redwood CS: Marissa Cole — evaluation logistics & acceptance checklist
- Pegasus Eng: Rajiv Menon — test data owner and infra contact
- Pegasus Procurement: Sarah Klein — MAP/SOW & vendor onboarding
- Pegasus Security: Mike O'Neil — SOC2 artifacts & network approval

Success criteria to validate during the POC (shortlist): 
1) Run representative workload end-to-end with latency under 400ms median for 512-token prompts
2) End-to-end integration with Pegasus auth flow (demo credential exchange)
3) No PII leakage in generated outputs on the sample prompt set
4) Signoff on a mutual action plan outlining next 30/60 day milestones

Attachments: Draft-Mutual-Action-Plan.docx (in Drive), POC-Agenda.pdf, Network-Access-Checklist.xlsx

If anyone's calendar changes, please reply-all with alternatives — otherwise we'll proceed and open a pre-kickoff prep doc in the Drive with tasks.

Looking forward to it —
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
